coordinate_contract: Full canvas, origin [0,0], x right/y down; keep source files and record trim offsets on any later crop.

reference_guidance.exact_named_source_evidence: Private analysis excluded from production packages.

perspective.camera: Side-on yard stage with gently elevated top/contact-plane visibility, compatible with inspected props. No extreme isometric or wide-angle lens.
perspective.scale: World scale remains provisional; scene pixels do not define canonical bird size.
perspective.verticals: Architecture and posts remain visually upright; repeated ground seams recede consistently.

lighting.shadow: Lower-right; attached tight contact shadows and broader low-contrast environment shade.
lighting.priority: Bird/contact readability must exceed decorative texture salience. No false claim before actual canonical bird check.

render_style.clusters: Connected naturalistic clusters, deliberate edge steps and restrained value ramps.
render_style.detail: Concentrate fine wear/material accents in placeable props and nearest edges; calm ground/distant masses.
render_style.distance: Cooler, paler, lower contrast and simpler than near framing.
render_style.avoid: Uniform pixel noise, smooth vector forms, thick framing border, copied scene layouts.

wind_hierarchy.constraint: Leaves may move with flexible branch groups; containers/trunks remain anchored. A single flattened canopy cannot supply per-leaf articulation.
wind_hierarchy.root_anchors_status: Proposed image geometry; no rig or physics implemented.
wind_hierarchy.seasonal_behavior: No blanket orange fall or snow default. Evergreen/cultivated/native state needs are per species and irrigation context.

proposed_artist_policy.stiffness_definition: Dimensionless artist resistance parameter0..1, larger meansless motion; not spring constant or measured physical stiffness.
proposed_artist_policy.caps_definition: Maximum absolute proposed rotation from rest and tip displacement at1536x1024 scene; both caps apply, choose more restrictive. No displacement of roots/contact pivots.

rigid.pivot_rule: Ground contact or fixed support. Do not sway architecture, pots, main trunks, main branches, ground or contact shadows.

flexible_branch.pivot_rule: Local flexible-branch joint where it meets static wood; unresolved joint staysnull and motiondisabled until alignmentreview.

foliage_mass.pivot_rule: Own leaf-mass root/branch anchor, not whole-scene pivot. Compoundgroupsrequireindividualextraction/masks.

grass_tip.pivot_rule: Base of isolated blade/tipgroup; lawnpaint/soil/rootline remainrigid. No whole-groundwarp.

art_safety_limits.alpha_or_lightness_flicker: No procedural opacity/color pulsation; nearest resampling or subpixel treatment must be reviewed for pixel shimmer.
art_safety_limits.review: Mild/strong areartistlabels only, no weather-speed conversion. Reject visible jointgaps, leafstretch, clippedtips or groundcontactdrift.

name: Compact Mediterranean courtyard — warm stone pocket
composition: A small enclosure with warm buff plaster returns, one shallow stone step at a side, quiet pale warm-gray paving, and an asymmetrical narrow gate opening. Keep the center open for iron/wood/terracotta placeables; small planted wall pockets frame only side edges. No pergola or broad vista.
region: San Diego managed Mediterranean-style exterior courtyard.

value_plan.stage: Quiet pale stone with sparse seam lines, avoiding the strong paver stripes in prior baseline.
value_plan.distance: Small cool sky opening and subdued neighboring roof hints.
value_plan.near_frame: Dark iron/woody side accents; warm terracotta highlights sparse.
